categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the renewable energy sector focusing on the production and sales of biodiesel and bio-based materials. Its main product lines include biodiesel, bio-ester plasticizers, industrial glycerin, environmentally friendly alkyd resins, and fatty acid mixed oils. The business is segmented into biodiesel production, bio-ester plasticizers, industrial glycerin, and alkyd resin manufacturing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced continuous production technology for high-quality ester-based biodiesel with a 99% transesterification rate and over 90% high-quality biodiesel yield. It has developed targeted impurity removal technologies for waste oils, optimized hydrogenation processes for hydrotreated vegetable oil (HVO) and sustainable aviation fuels, and integrates digital and intelligent manufacturing technologies to enhance production efficiency and safety. The company also invests in catalyst development, energy-saving processes, and bio-based chemical product innovation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic and international buyers in the transportation fuel sector, bio-based materials market, plastic products, and surface active agents industries. The company mainly exports biodiesel to Europe, with significant sales in the Netherlands and Singapore, and serves domestic markets for bio-based materials. Major customers are high-quality clients in Europe and Southeast Asia, including direct sales and trade partners.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Longyan and Xiamen, and has established subsidiaries and sales platforms in the Netherlands, Singapore, and Thailand. It actively expands its presence in European, Southeast Asian, and Middle Eastern markets, including a regional headquarters in Saudi Arabia for Middle East projects.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on processing waste oils into biodiesel and bio-based materials. It controls raw material procurement, production, and direct sales, including export operations, and has developed a stable supply chain network for waste oils domestically and in Southeast Asia.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing technology for waste oil purification, improving biodiesel quality, expanding hydrotreated biofuel production, and developing bio-based materials with higher added value. The company emphasizes digitalization and intelligent manufacturing, collaborates with domestic and international research institutions, and focuses on sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) and marine biofuels. R&D investments target energy efficiency, pollution control, and new product development in bio-based chemicals and advanced fuels.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of biodiesel and bio-based materials. Sales are conducted via direct sales and trade channels, with export sales settled mainly through letters of credit and domestic sales on a payment-before-delivery basis. The company also benefits from government subsidies related to its renewable energy products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is the leading domestic producer and exporter of biodiesel from waste oils in China, holding the top position in production volume and export quantity for several years. It is recognized as a national high-tech enterprise and a key player in the renewable bioenergy industry, with advanced technology and a comprehensive product chain that differentiates it from competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.56 billion, a 26.73% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 149 million, up 89.57%. Total assets reached RMB 3.57 billion, growing 16.3%, with equity of RMB 2.79 billion. The company has shown steady growth in sales volume and profitability, supported by expanding production capacity and international market development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its high-quality, environmentally friendly biodiesel produced from waste oils with a high transesterification rate and advanced impurity removal technology. Its integrated bioenergy and bio-based materials production chain enhances resource utilization efficiency and product value. The company’s products meet international sustainability certifications (ISCC) and cater to emerging markets like sustainable aviation fuel and marine biofuels, offering clean, renewable alternatives to fossil fuels with strong carbon reduction benefits.
